ideas.title: Investigating the ICE Shooting of Renee Good
ideas.description: This story would investigate the circumstances surrounding the shooting of Renee Good by an ICE agent and the subsequent decision by the DOJ not to investigate.
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting of Renee Good?
Why did the DOJ decide not to investigate the shooting?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of wrongdoing within the ICE and DOJ. By investigating the shooting and the subsequent decision not to investigate, we may be able to shed light on a lack of transparency and accountability within these agencies.
